pages.title: Making Celenegil
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Orichalcum + 1 Platinum = 2 Celenegil

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 521 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 5.$(br)Mining efficiency: 8.2.$(br)Material damage bonus: 4.8.$(br)Enchantability: 23.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 4, chestplate 6, leggings 5, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 4.0.$(br)Enchantability: 23.

pages.title: Tool: Escalation
pages.text: Continuously breaking blocks without stopping doesn't use durability and increases mining speed. (Resets after pausing for more than a second, the unbreakable effect is enabled after 5 blocks mined)

pages.title: Armor: Perseverance
pages.text: After being attacked five times over a short period, all the enemies are knocked back away from the player and the player receives a very short regen buff and all negative effects are cleared.

pages.title: Weapon: Glory Seeker
pages.text: On right click, Grants a small damage buff to the weapon damage but when you damage an entity without killing it, it'll go on a short cooldown while it will give the player some short speed and strength buff if they manage to kill the entity
